name: Chef Marco Santini
title: Head of Culinary Arts
bio: A classically trained French chef with 20 years of experience across Michelin-starred restaurants in Paris, Milan, and Dubai. Marco brings rigorous technique and infectious passion to every class.
credentials: Former Head Chef, Hotel Georges V

name: Chef Sophie Laurent
title: Pastry & Baking Specialist
bio: Sophie trained at the École Nationale Supérieure de Pâtisserie and spent a decade perfecting her craft in world-class patisseries. She makes the complex world of pastry approachable and delicious.

name: Elena Vasquez
title: Coffee Arts & Beverage Lead
bio: A certified Q Grader and multiple latte art competition winner, Elena has traveled across coffee-producing regions and brings that depth of knowledge into every session.

name: James Okafor
title: Mixology & Bar Arts Instructor
bio: James has helmed bars in London, New York, and Lagos, earning recognition for his inventive West African-inspired cocktails. He teaches with flair and precision.

name: Nadia Khalil
title: Beauty & Makeup Lead Artist
bio: With credits spanning Vogue Arabia, Dubai Fashion Week, and major film productions, Nadia is one of the region's most respected makeup artists. She teaches the art and business of beauty.

name: Yuki Tanaka
title: Fashion Design & Styling Director
bio: After graduating from Central Saint Martins and working with Comme des Garçons and Dries Van Noten, Yuki now channels her expertise into nurturing the next generation of designers.
credentials: Former Designer at Comme des Garçons

name: David Chen
title: Computer Applications & Office Suite Specialist
bio: With 15 years of corporate training experience and Microsoft Certified Trainer credentials, David has helped thousands of professionals master essential computer skills and boost their productivity.

name: Sarah Martinez
title: Web Development & Programming Lead
bio: A full-stack developer turned educator, Sarah has built applications for Fortune 500 companies and now shares her passion for coding with aspiring developers. She makes programming accessible and fun.
